name: bakerydemo
comment: Wagtail's official demo (github.com/wagtail/bakerydemo), the first third-party subject. Clone it, `uv pip install -r requirements/development.txt`, copy local.py.example and .env.example, migrate + load_initial_data (admin/changeme), then serve it with that venv's python on PATH: `PATH=/path/to/bakerydemo/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 scripts/soak.py --manifest scripts/soak_manifests/bakerydemo.json --serve 'bin/m0serve bakerydemo.wsgi --app-dir /path/to/bakerydemo --port 8370 --metrics' --url http://127.0.0.1:8370 --capture bakerydemo-gunicorn.json`. Record the capture from gunicorn first (`--baseline`), because self-pinning cannot see a defect that was already there on request one.
comment_headers_ignore: transfer-encoding is a per-server FRAMING choice (measured 2026-09-01 against uvicorn): decoded bytes are identical and the digest still compares them.
comment_body_sub: Measured: two fetches of every admin page differ ONLY in the wagtail-config CSRF_TOKEN line and the csrfmiddlewaretoken form inputs. Both patterns are bounded by the closing quote, which is what the blinding lint requires. The bulk-action button's class order flips between PROCESSES (Wagtail builds it from a set, so it follows the hash seed): gunicorn's own workers disagree with each other the same way. Bounded by the trailing space. Site history renders edit times as `N minutes ago`, which moves between the baseline and the run; bounded by `ago`. Site history's pagination label names whichever log model Wagtail's registry set yields first (`log_action_registry.get_log_entry_models()`), so it flips between `model log entries` and `page log entries` with the interpreter's hash seed -- measured on m0serve alone across four seeds. Same cause as the class order.
